title: Pendulum results sheet with example data
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Review of Key Stage 3 and working scientifically (9C)
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 48 (Pendulum results sheet with example data and answers (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 48. Use your own results or the example data. Circle anomalies, find means and ranges, then draw a line graph.

blocks.answers: 25 cm: mean 10.0, range 0.2; 50 cm: mean 14.2 (19.6 is an anomaly), range 0.2; 75 cm: mean 17.4, range 0.3; 100 cm: mean 20.1, range 0.2

questions.q: Describe the pattern. Is time proportional to length?
questions.a: Time rises with length but not proportionally: doubling from 25 to 50 cm does not double the time.

questions.q: Suggest two ways to reduce random error.
questions.a: Time 20 swings; use a marker at the centre; video and count frames.
